textarea.$description: v0.6 — Textarea inherits the input shell. This file declares the multiline-only deltas: min/max heights, vertical padding, resize behavior. State + slot tokens come from input.*.

max-height.$description: Cap auto-grow so a runaway textarea doesn't push everything off screen. Beyond cap, the textarea scrolls internally.

y.$description: Top/bottom padding. Differs from input.padding.y because multiline anchors at top.

resize.$description: Default resize handle. Set to 'none' for fixed-size textareas; 'both' is discouraged because it breaks page rhythm.
